posts.title: Seniority Alone Won't Get You Hired Anymore
posts.description: When a developer tells me they have fifteen years of experience, I ask about their AI experience and what they’ve built with agents. The answer I keep getting is some version of “I’ve used the free version, but I run out of tokens so I can’t do much.” Then comes the part that surprises me more. posts.title: Your AI Agent Can Build Anything. Does It Know Your Business?
posts.description: Your AI agent will build anything you ask for. A new dashboard, a settings page, a whole integration, in a session or two. It won’t ask whether any of it makes you money. Without business context, it doesn’t know what moves your MRR or who your ICP is, so it just builds. That used to be fine, because building was slow and the slowness did the filtering for you. posts.title: The Next Languages Won't Be Written For Us
posts.description: Something changed in how I build and I only caught it looking backwards. I used to have real opinions about frameworks. Which one I’d reach for, what its conventions got right, where it would start fighting me six months in. That was a genuine part of the job and I was good at it.
